# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **No Thoughts Forest Dress Up** as a mobile-first browser dress-up game. Preserve the source mechanics: start screen, tabbed hair/tops/bottoms/shoes categories, tap-to-equip items, selected tile highlighting, blocked feedback when tapping an already equipped item, a reveal/success state with confetti, restart, mute, and continuous canvas preview. Do not add scores, timers, outfit matching rules, penalties, fail states, drag-and-drop, or collision mechanics.

Transform presentation into a cozy satirical fairycore moss atelier inspired by the prompt: Dress Up. A satirical game inspired by Studio Ghibli built around dress up play, with cozy, creative, satisfying energy, weekend chill session design, search-friendly hooks like dress up, fashion, makeover, aesthetics like plushie aesthetic, studio ghibli vibes, fairycore, and meme-tone cues such as main character, no thoughts head empty. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The focal actor is a plush blank-brain woodland main character. Use procedural Canvas/CSS forms for the forest atelier, mushroom lamps, fairy glints, soft doll body, and wardrobe pieces. Keep mobile portrait readability and one-thumb controls central.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile-first paper-doll dress-up customization game.
- objective: Choose hair, top, bottom, and shoes for a central avatar, then reveal the finished look.
- input model: One-tap start, tab switching, item selection, reveal, mute, and restart; no drag, physics, or keyboard dependency.
- core loop: Start the session, browse category tabs, tap outfit tiles to update the canvas doll, receive blocked feedback for reselecting the current tile, reveal the final look, then restart styling.
- fail/friction state: There is no loss state; the only friction is repeated-selection feedback that does not change the outfit.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve tabbed category selection for hair, tops, bottoms, and shoes.
- Preserve instant tap-to-equip item behavior and selected-state highlighting.
- Preserve repeated-choice blocked feedback without penalties.
- Preserve continuous canvas redraw and avatar preview.
- Preserve reveal as the success/terminal state with confetti and restart.
- Preserve mobile native tap/click actionability and user-gesture-safe audio.

## Remixed target
A cozy satirical fairycore dress-up game called **No Thoughts Forest Dress Up** where the player styles a plush blank-brain woodland main character in a moss atelier. The mechanics remain a simple paper-doll makeover loop, but the world, copy, procedural avatar, forest background, item names, feedback, audio mood, and mobile HUD all express plushie aesthetic, fairycore, weekend chill, and meme-tone cues.
